property_summary: For any callee address and any sent value, the reference contract never reverts when sendMoney is called (it returns successfully even if the callee's fallback reverts), whereas the mutant reverts when the external call fails; the test checks that calling sendMoney against a reverting helper never causes C.sendMoney to revert in the reference.
change_summary: Use call but check the returned success and revert on failure, making sendMoney revert on failed sends instead of silently continuing.
